form.label: App ACL - write audit
form.description: What was changed at application level, by whom, when - and what will never be undone. Read the entitlement check first: an empty view does not prove that no write took place.

search.query: `app_acl_journal_source` | stats count AS journal_events, max(_time) AS last_journal_event, values(index) AS journal_read_from | appendcols [| eventcount summarize=false index=* index=_* | stats count AS searchable_index_count, values(index) AS searchable_indexes] | appendcols [| tstats count AS ingested_events WHERE (index=* OR index=_*) sourcetype=editappacl:journal BY index | stats sum(ingested_events) AS ingested_events, values(index) AS journal_found_in] | eval searchable_index_count = coalesce(searchable_index_count, 0) | eval journal_events = coalesce(journal_events, 0) | eval ingested_events = coalesce(ingested_events, 0) | eval unread_events = ingested_events - journal_events | eval read_index_count = coalesce(mvcount(journal_read_from), 0) | eval found_index_count = coalesce(mvcount(journal_found_in), 0) | eval state = case( searchable_index_count == 0, "NO SEARCHABLE INDEX - your role has no index entitlement", unread_events > 0 OR found_index_count > read_index_count, "JOURNAL LINES SIT OUTSIDE WHAT THIS VIEW READS - the index was redirected in inputs.conf without overriding the source macro", journal_events == 0, "NO EVENT IN THIS WINDOW - no run recorded, or this journal lands where you cannot search", 1==1, "OK - the application-level journal is readable and carries events in this window") | table state, journal_events, unread_events, journal_read_from, journal_found_in, searchable_index_count, searchable_indexes

html.p: These writes are not covered by app_acl_rollback, by construction. why tells the two cases apart: permissions were materialised where none existed, or the provenance could not be established at write time. Click a row to inspect the run that produced it.

search.query: `app_acl_irreversible(*)` | eval created_value = "read=[" . coalesce('acl_after_perms_read',"") . "] write=[" . coalesce('acl_after_perms_write',"") . "] sharing=" . coalesce('acl_after_sharing',"") | eval masked_value = "read=[" . coalesce('acl_inherited_perms_read',"") . "] write=[" . coalesce('acl_inherited_perms_write',"") . "] sharing=" . coalesce('acl_inherited_sharing',"") | eval target = coalesce('eai:acl.app',"(no app)") . " " . if(acl_stanza_kind=="app_default", "[]", "[" . coalesce(acl_stanza,"?") . "]") | eval why = if(acl_reversible=="false", "permissions were materialised", "provenance was unreadable") | table _time, sid, user, target, why, created_value, masked_value, acl_impacted_estimate, endpoint | sort - _time

html.p: Click a row to inspect it. targets processed counts generic stanzas, never knowledge objects. run_state comes from the end-of-run line: its absence is the signal of an interruption, not a gap.

search.query: `app_acl_journal_source` | stats min(_time) AS started, max(_time) AS ended, values(user) AS user, values(dryrun) AS mode, count(eval(phase=="outcome")) AS targets_processed, count(eval(phase=="outcome" AND (status=="updated" OR status=="created"))) AS stanzas_written, count(eval(phase=="outcome" AND status=="created")) AS irreversible, count(eval(phase=="outcome" AND (status=="noop" OR status=="noop_inherited"))) AS noop, count(eval(phase=="outcome" AND (status=="rejected" OR status=="not_found" OR status=="forbidden" OR status=="invalid_role" OR status=="skipped_ceiling" OR status=="skipped_impact_ceiling"))) AS refused, count(eval(phase=="outcome" AND status=="error")) AS errors, count(eval(phase=="summary")) AS summary_lines, dc(app) AS apps, sum(eval(if(phase=="intent", impacted_estimate, 0))) AS objects_moved_estimate BY sid | eval run_state = case( summary_lines == 1, "completed", summary_lines == 0, "INTERRUPTED - no end-of-run line", 1==1, "ANOMALY - several end-of-run lines") | eval mode = if(mvcount(mode) > 1, "MIXED - anomaly", if(mode=="true", "simulation", "real")) | table started, sid, user, mode, run_state, targets_processed, stanzas_written, irreversible, noop, refused, errors, apps, objects_moved_estimate | sort - started | convert ctime(started)

panel.title: Runs started with no journal line

html.p: Present in the diagnostic, absent from the journal. journal_disabled: the run was launched with journal=false. journal_not_openable: the file could not be opened. fatal_error: the run stopped before writing. no_write_recorded: nothing was established - the two columns beside it are the evidence, and they are empty here.
Only one direction is a signal. A run may appear in the journal and not in the diagnostic: that file is rotated, and it may not have opened.

search.query: | multisearch [search `app_acl_journal_source`] [search `app_acl_diag_source`] | eval diag_raw = if(sourcetype=="editappacl:diag", _raw, null()) | rex field=diag_raw "^\S+\s+(?<diag_level>[A-Z]+)\s+sid=(?<diag_sid>\S+)" | rex field=diag_raw "\bversion=\S+\s+user=(?<diag_user>\S+)\s" | rex field=diag_raw "\bjournal=(?<diag_journal>\S+)\s" | rex field=diag_raw "(?<diag_journal_file>editappacl_journal\S*\.log)" | eval sid = coalesce(diag_sid, sid) | stats count(eval(sourcetype=="editappacl:journal")) AS journal_lines, count(eval(sourcetype=="editappacl:diag")) AS diag_lines, min(eval(if(sourcetype=="editappacl:diag", _time, null()))) AS started, values(diag_user) AS run_user, values(diag_journal) AS journal_param, count(eval(diag_level=="CRITICAL")) AS fatal_lines, count(eval(diag_level=="WARNING" AND isnotnull(diag_journal_file))) AS journal_open_failures BY sid | where journal_lines == 0 AND diag_lines > 0 | eval cause = case( journal_param=="false", "journal_disabled", journal_open_failures > 0, "journal_not_openable", fatal_lines > 0, "fatal_error", 1==1, "no_write_recorded") | sort - started | convert ctime(started) | table started, sid, run_user, cause, fatal_lines, journal_open_failures

p.b: objects moved (estimate) is an estimate, never a count.

html.p: It under-counts: a stanza naming a private or deleted object removes one unit with no enumerated object to match it.
On a target describing the application default, only the families of the tool's table can be enumerated - a lower bound.
An account without admin_all_objects sees a truncated population - a lower bound.
Private objects are excluded from the count, and whether they inherit from the generic stanzas has not been measured.

search.query: `app_acl_journal_source` | search sid="$sid$" | stats min(_time) AS started, max(_time) AS ended, values(user) AS user, values(dryrun) AS mode, count(eval(phase=="outcome")) AS targets_processed, count(eval(phase=="outcome" AND status=="created")) AS irreversible, count(eval(phase=="summary")) AS summary_lines, sum(eval(if(phase=="intent", impacted_estimate, 0))) AS objects_moved_estimate, values(eval(if(phase=="summary", impacted_estimate_total, null()))) AS declared_estimate_total | eval run_state = case(summary_lines == 1, "completed", summary_lines == 0, "INTERRUPTED - no end-of-run line", 1==1, "ANOMALY - several end-of-run lines") | eval mode = if(mvcount(mode) > 1, "MIXED - anomaly", if(mode=="true", "simulation", "real")) | eval duration_s = round(ended - started, 3) | convert ctime(started) | table started, user, mode, run_state, targets_processed, irreversible, objects_moved_estimate, declared_estimate_total, duration_s

html.p: Click a row in Runs or in Irreversible writes in this window, or paste a sid in the field at the top, to open the five detail panels.
observed counts the output lines of the run; declared reads the counters of its end-of-run line. n/a means the run was interrupted and declared nothing - never a discrepancy of zero.

search.query: `app_acl_journal_source` | search sid="$sid$" | eval observed_status = if(phase=="outcome", status, null()) | stats count(eval(isnotnull(observed_status))) AS observed BY observed_status | rename observed_status AS status | append [search `app_acl_journal_source` | search sid="$sid$" phase="summary" | transpose 0 column_name="counter" | rename "row 1" AS declared | where substr(counter, 1, 6) == "count_" | eval status = replace(counter, "^count_", "") | fields status, declared] | stats sum(observed) AS observed, sum(declared) AS declared BY status | eval observed = coalesce(observed, 0), declared = coalesce(declared, 0) | eventstats sum(declared) AS declared_total | where observed > 0 OR declared > 0 | eval consistency = case(declared_total == 0, "n/a - no end-of-run line", observed == declared, "=", 1==1, "MISMATCH - lines are missing from the journal") | table status, observed, declared, consistency | sort - observed

panel.title: Stanzas written - before, after, and what a rollback covers

html.p: before shows the previous value when the write is reversible, and the inherited value it masks when it is not - the two are never mixed. write_asserted reads unknown when a non-2xx answer leaves the state of the target undetermined: no column here claims that a failure means nothing moved.

search.query: `app_acl_journal_source` | search sid="$sid$" | where isnotnull(endpoint) AND endpoint != "" | stats values(app) AS app, values(stanza_kind) AS stanza_kind, values(stanza) AS stanza, values(handler) AS handler, values(reversible) AS reversible, values(impacted_estimate) AS objects_moved_estimate, earliest(before_perms_read) AS before_read, earliest(before_perms_write) AS before_write, earliest(before_sharing) AS before_sharing, earliest(inherited_perms_read) AS inherited_read, earliest(inherited_perms_write) AS inherited_write, earliest(after_perms_read) AS after_read, earliest(after_perms_write) AS after_write, earliest(after_sharing) AS after_sharing, values(eval(if(phase=="outcome", status, null()))) AS status, values(eval(if(phase=="outcome", http_code, null()))) AS http_code, values(eval(if(phase=="outcome", write_asserted, null()))) AS write_asserted BY endpoint | eval target = coalesce(app,"(no app)") . " " . if(stanza_kind=="app_default", "[]", "[" . coalesce(stanza,"?") . "]") | eval rollback = case( reversible == "true", "covered by app_acl_rollback", reversible == "false", "NOT COVERED - permissions were materialised", reversible == "unknown", "NOT COVERED - provenance was unreadable", 1==1, "n/a") | eval before = if(reversible=="true", "read=[" . coalesce(before_read,"") . "] write=[" . coalesce(before_write,"") . "] sharing=" . coalesce(before_sharing,""), "(inherited) read=[" . coalesce(inherited_read,"") . "] write=[" . coalesce(inherited_write,"") . "]") | eval after = "read=[" . coalesce(after_read,"") . "] write=[" . coalesce(after_write,"") . "] sharing=" . coalesce(after_sharing,"") | table target, stanza_kind, status, rollback, before, after, objects_moved_estimate, http_code, write_asserted, endpoint | sort target

html.p: Targets on which no write was attempted. A duplicate target appears here in plain sight, as rejected with a reason - which is why no column of this view counts distinct endpoints. An empty endpoint means the target was refused before it could be resolved.

search.query: `app_acl_journal_source` | search sid="$sid$" phase="outcome" | where status IN ("rejected","not_found","forbidden","invalid_role","skipped_ceiling","skipped_impact_ceiling","noop","noop_inherited") | eval target = coalesce(app,"(no app)") . " " . if(stanza_kind=="app_default", "[]", "[" . coalesce(stanza,"?") . "]") | eval reason = coalesce(error, "") | table _time, target, stanza_kind, status, reason, endpoint | sort target

html.p: Grouped by a stable class rather than by raw message: the message carries a response body truncated at 512 characters and does not group. http_code 0 means no HTTP exchange took place at all, which is its own class rather than a code.

search.query: `app_acl_journal_source` | search sid="$sid$" phase="outcome" | where status=="error" OR (isnum(http_code) AND http_code >= 400) | eval error_class = case( isnum(http_code) AND http_code >= 500, "5xx - server", http_code == 403, "403 - forbidden", http_code == 404, "404 - not found", http_code == 400, "400 - refused by handler", http_code == 0, "no HTTP exchange", 1==1, "other") | stats count AS events, values(write_asserted) AS write_asserted, values(app) AS apps, latest(error) AS sample_message BY error_class | sort - events

html.p: Targets filtered upstream of the pipeline. They never reached the command.
Output warnings (acl_warning). They are not journalled, and cannot be reconstituted.
The calling SPL, and the intent of the batch - a write or a rollback. The SPL lives in the platform audit index, out of reach of this role; the intent is journalled nowhere.
What a write really moved. The journal carries an estimate; the real count would require an enumeration the command does not perform.
Concurrent runs on the same target. Two runs may both classify a target as a creation and only one journal it as such.
The state of a target after a non-2xx answer. write_asserted reads unknown: the failure is not atomic, and that is measured.
